temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was a dedicated, hardworking friend but may not have appreciated how severe Gary's stress and unhealthy habits had become.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan now sees Gary's overwork as serious and health-threatening, and he learns Gary is unwilling or unable to take a break because of hospital demands.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is severely overworked and at risk, but he currently prioritizes hospital duties over rest and self-care.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and somewhat disappointed or frustrated by Gary's refusal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary address his overwork and health, perhaps by persuading him to rest or finding another way to support him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. When Ethan says he can tell him anything, Gary says it's complicated and he didn't want to burden him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is severely overworked and resistant to taking a break, likely due mainly to hospital obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's behavior and reluctance to discuss work make Ethan suspect there is a deeper, possibly personal problem beyond professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is hiding something painful or complicated; his overwork is not just about the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary and offer nonjudgmental support so he will open up.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges. He accepts Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary's overwork has deeper causes beyond professional obligations, but he does not yet know the specifics.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's disclosure confirms that both professional pressure and personal challenges are driving his behavior.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overwhelmed by work and personal issues, but he is willing to accept help and can improve with better organization and delegation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and find a healthier balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports progress, feels less overwhelmed, and even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overwhelmed but can improve with support and better organization.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's reports and efforts show that the support is working and he is making real progress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is improving and becoming less overwhelmed, though he still benefits from encouragement and check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, supporting, and encouraging Gary.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and says he feels more in control. He thanks Ethan for his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is improving but still benefits from encouragement and support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary now appears capable of managing his work-life balance independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary can manage on his own; Ethan can step back while remaining available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active intervention but let Gary know he is always available.
